Luka Doncic scored the Lakers' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 20 times in 64 starts, or 31% of the games they started. LeBron James was next with 18. The Lakers made the game's first field goal in 59% of their 92 games and won 68% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
